```{r helpers, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- WHO standard population (ages 20-95+) for ASMR -------------------------
full_who_std <- data.table(
  age    = 0:100,
  weight = c(
    rep(0.013, 10), rep(0.014, 10), rep(0.013, 10), rep(0.012, 10),
    rep(0.011, 10), rep(0.009, 10), rep(0.007, 10), rep(0.005, 10),
    rep(0.003, 10), rep(0.001, 10), 0.001
  )
)
who_std <- full_who_std[age >= 20 & age <= 94]
who_std <- rbind(
  who_std,
  data.table(age = 95, weight = full_who_std[age >= 95, sum(weight)])
)
who_std[, weight := weight / sum(weight)]

calculate_asmr <- function(dt, std_pop = who_std,
                            deaths_col = "deaths_dx",
                            population_col = "Nx",
                            disagg_var = "intervention") {
  dt <- copy(dt)
  dt[, age := as.integer(gsub("\\+", "", age))]
  dt <- merge(dt, std_pop, by = "age", all.x = TRUE)
  dt[, rate          := get(deaths_col) / get(population_col)]
  dt[, weighted_rate := rate * weight]
  group_vars <- c("year", disagg_var)
  dt[, .(ASMR = sum(weighted_rate, na.rm = TRUE) * 1e5), by = group_vars]
}

# ---- Deaths-delayed calculator -----------------------------------------------
deaths_summary <- function(dt,
                           baseline_label = "Counterfactual",
                           by_cols = c("age_group", "sex", "year",
                                       "location", "cause", "age"),
                           value_col = "dead") {
  stopifnot(is.data.table(dt))
  n_interventions <- uniqueN(dt[intervention != baseline_label, intervention])
  baseline_cols   <- setdiff(by_cols, "intervention")
  baseline   <- dt[intervention == baseline_label,
                   .(baseline_deaths = sum(get(value_col), na.rm = TRUE)),
                   by = baseline_cols]
  nonbaseline <- dt[intervention != baseline_label,
                    .(deaths_projected = sum(get(value_col), na.rm = TRUE)),
                    by = by_cols]
  if (!("intervention" %in% by_cols))
    nonbaseline[, deaths_projected := deaths_projected / n_interventions]
  merged <- merge(nonbaseline, baseline, by = baseline_cols,
                  all.x = TRUE, allow.cartesian = TRUE)
  merged[, deaths_delayed     := baseline_deaths - deaths_projected]
  merged[, deaths_delayed_ave := deaths_delayed / uniqueN(dt$year)]
  merged[, deaths_delayed_pct := deaths_delayed / baseline_deaths]
  merged[]
}
```

```{r load-model-output, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Load all country-level model output RDS files --------------------------
# Generated by 06_run_scenarios_assessment.R (program-impact mode)
out_model_path <- paste0(wd_outp, "out_model/")
files <- list.files(path = out_model_path, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)

if (length(files) == 0)
  stop(paste0("No .rds files found in: ", out_model_path,
              "\nRun 06_run_scenarios_assessment.R first."))

data.out <- rbindlist(
  lapply(files, function(f) { dt <- readRDS(f); setDT(dt); dt }),
  use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE
)
data.out <- data.out[!is.na(location)]

# Drop effect-ratio tracking columns if present
for (col in c("eff_ir", "eff_cf"))
  if (col %in% names(data.out)) data.out[, (col) := NULL]

# ---- Standardise scenario -> intervention labels ----------------------------
# The output has a 'scenario' column (baseline, bp_only, tfa_only, bp_tfa)
# and a 'rate_scenario' column (program, bau_upper)
if ("scenario" %in% names(data.out) && !"intervention" %in% names(data.out)) {
  setnames(data.out, "scenario", "intervention")
} else if ("scenario" %in% names(data.out)) {
  data.out[, intervention := scenario]
  data.out[, scenario := NULL]
}

# Ensure rate_scenario column exists
if (!"rate_scenario" %in% names(data.out))
  data.out[, rate_scenario := "program"]

# ---- Remap intervention labels -----------------------------------------------
data.out[intervention %in% c("baseline", "BAU", "b.a.u"),
         intervention := "Counterfactual"]
data.out[intervention %in% c("bp_only", "antihypertensive", "BP",
                              "Antihypertensive therapy"),
         intervention := "HTN Control (Program)"]
data.out[intervention %in% c("tfa_only", "tfa", "TFA"),
         intervention := "TFA Elimination"]
data.out[intervention %in% c("bp_tfa"),
         intervention := "HTN Control + TFA Elimination"]

# Keep only recognised scenarios
data.out <- data.out[intervention %in% c("Counterfactual", int_order)]

# HTN control countries
dt_htn_control_scenarios <- fread(paste0(wd_data, "htn_control_scenarios_by_loc_year.csv"))

htn_countries_include <- unique(dt_htn_control_scenarios[, location])

# Remove countries not included in RTSL TFA calculations (if any slipped in)
dt_tfa_scenarios <- readRDS(file = paste0(wd_data,"tfa_policy_scenarios_assessment.rds"))

tfa_countries_include <- unique(dt_tfa_scenarios[tfa_rtsl_include == "Yes", location])

countries_include <- unique(c(htn_countries_include, tfa_countries_include))

## Filter model output to included countries only
data.out <- data.out[location %in% countries_include]
# ---- Separate program and counterfactual runs --------------------------------
# Program-attributable impact:
#   deaths_averted = deaths(bau_upper) - deaths(program)
# For the report, we use:
#   - rate_scenario == "bau_upper" as the Counterfactual
#   - rate_scenario == "program"   as the Intervention
data_program <- data.out[rate_scenario == "program"]
data_bau     <- data.out[rate_scenario == "bau_upper"]

# ---- Age groups --------------------------------------------------------------
data_program[, age_group := cut(age, breaks = c(0, 70, 80, 90, Inf),
                                labels = c("<70", "70-79", "80-89", "90+"),
                                right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)]
data_bau[, age_group := cut(age, breaks = c(0, 70, 80, 90, Inf),
                            labels = c("<70", "70-79", "80-89", "90+"),
                            right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE)]

# ---- Merge region metadata ---------------------------------------------------
if (nrow(countries_dt) > 0) {
  region_lookup <- countries_dt[, .(location, region)]
  region_lookup <- unique(region_lookup)
  data_program <- merge(data_program, region_lookup, by = "location", all.x = TRUE)
  data_bau     <- merge(data_bau,     region_lookup, by = "location", all.x = TRUE)
}
if (!"region" %in% names(data_program)) data_program[, region := NA_character_]
if (!"region" %in% names(data_bau))     data_bau[, region := NA_character_]

# ---- Key summary counts ------------------------------------------------------
n_countries <- uniqueN(data_program$location)
year_min    <- min(data_program$year, na.rm = TRUE)
year_max    <- max(data_program$year, na.rm = TRUE)
study_years <- paste0(year_min, "\u2013", year_max)
```

---

# Background

This report presents modelled projections of cardiovascular disease (CVD) mortality
attributable to **Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) cardiovascular health programs**
operating in `r n_countries` countries from 2017 to 2024. The central research question is:

> *What is the expected health impact --- in terms of deaths averted ---
> of RTSL cardiovascular health programs from 2017--2024 in targeted populations,
> projected to 2050?*

Two interventions are assessed:

1. **Improved hypertension control** --- observed program-level blood pressure control
   rates (2017--2024) are maintained at 2024 levels through 2050, compared to a
   counterfactual scenario with no incremental program effect.
2. **Industrial trans-fat elimination (TFA)** --- policy-driven elimination of
   industrial trans-fatty acids in countries with enacted or effective TFA policies
   by end of 2024.

Four causes of CVD death are modelled jointly: ischemic heart disease (IHD), ischemic
stroke, intracerebral hemorrhage (hemorrhagic stroke), and hypertensive heart disease (HHD).
A discrete-time multi-state transition model (Well $\rightarrow$ Sick $\rightarrow$ Dead) is calibrated to GBD 2023
data and projected forward to 2050 using UNWPP 2024 population estimates.

---

# Study Design

## Countries Included

The `r n_countries` countries with RTSL program data are:

```{r country-list, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
dt_countries <- unique(data_program[, .(location, region)])
setorder(dt_countries, region, location)
countries_by_region <- dt_countries[,
  .(Countries = paste0(sort(location), collapse = ", ")),
  by = .(Region = region)
]
setorder(countries_by_region, Region)

kable(countries_by_region,
      caption = "Countries included in the assessment, by region.",
      align = "ll") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = TRUE, font_size = 13) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

## Intervention Definitions

| Intervention | Description |
|---|---|
| **HTN Control (Program)** | Antihypertensive therapy scale-up using observed RTSL program control rates. Baseline BP distributions are shifted based on Ettehad et al. cumulative effect sizes for each 10 mmHg BP bin. Program enrollment data (2017--2024) define the treated population; control rates are maintained at 2024 levels through 2050. |
| **TFA Elimination** | Complete elimination of industrial trans-fatty acids (target: 0% energy from TFA). Applied to countries with enacted/effective TFA best-practice policies by end of 2024, with a 2-year lag from policy passage to population-level effect. |
| **HTN Control + TFA Elimination** | Both interventions applied simultaneously with multiplicative effect combination. |

## Scenario Structure

The model is run in **program-rate mode**: each country is simulated twice:

1. **Program run** (`rate_scenario = "program"`): observed RTSL control rates applied
2. **Counterfactual run** (`rate_scenario = "bau_upper"`): zero incremental program effect

The **program-attributable impact** is the difference: deaths under counterfactual minus deaths under program.

## Projection Horizon

- **Program enrollment data**: 2017--2024 (from HTN global tracker)
- **Model projection**: `r study_years`
- **Impact assessment window**: 2017--2050
- **Age range**: 20--95 years

```{r htn-program-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
htn_scenarios <- tryCatch(

  error = function(e) NULL

if (!is.null(htn_scenarios)) {
  # Plot observed + projected program control rates
  dt_plot <- htn_scenarios[year <= 2050, .(location, year,
                                            control_rate = control_rate_program,
                                            observed = control_rate_observed)]

  g <- ggplot(dt_plot, aes(x = year, y = control_rate * 100, group = location)) +
    geom_line(color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
    # Highlight observed data points
    geom_point(data = dt_plot[observed == 1],
               aes(x = year, y = control_rate * 100),
               color = "#1f78b4", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2017, 2050, 5),
                       limits = c(2017, 2051), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 60), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title    = "RTSL Hypertension Control Rates by Country",
      subtitle = "Observed (dots) and projected (maintained at 2024 level) program control rates",
      x = "Year", y = "Hypertension Control Rate (%)"

  ggsave(paste0(wd_outp, "assessment_policy_htn_program.png"), plot = g,
         width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 300)
} else {
  message("htn_control_scenarios_by_loc_year.csv not found - skipping HTN program plot.")
}
```

# Disease Trends (Baseline)

## Incidence and Prevalence Over Time

```{r disease-trends, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
# Use counterfactual (bau_upper) as the baseline trend
dt_trend <- data_bau[intervention == "Counterfactual" & year >= 2017,
                     .(new_cases = sum(newcases, na.rm = TRUE),
                       sick      = sum(sick,     na.rm = TRUE),
                       pop       = sum(pop,      na.rm = TRUE)),
                     by = year]

dt_melt <- melt(dt_trend, id.vars = "year",
                measure.vars  = c("new_cases", "sick"),
                variable.name = "metric", value.name = "count")
dt_melt[, metric_lbl := fifelse(metric == "new_cases", "Incident cases", "Prevalent cases")]

g <- ggplot(dt_melt, aes(x = year, y = count / 1e6,
                          color = metric_lbl, linetype = year > 2024)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Incident cases"  = "steelblue",
                                "Prevalent cases" = "tomato"),
                     name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "solid", `TRUE` = "dashed"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title    = "Incident and Prevalent CVD Cases \u2014 Counterfactual Scenario",
    subtitle = paste0("All four causes combined across ", n_countries,
                      " RTSL countries; solid = historical, dashed = projected"),
    x = "Year", y = "Persons (millions)",
    caption = "Source: Model output; ages 20\u201395+"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
print(g)
ggsave(paste0(wd_outp, "assessment_disease_trend.png"), plot = g,
       width = 11, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r asmr-cause, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
dt_asmr_in <- data_bau[intervention == "Counterfactual" & year >= 2017,
                        .(deaths_dx = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE),
                          well      = sum(well, na.rm = TRUE),
                          sick      = sum(sick, na.rm = TRUE)),
                        by = .(cause, age, year)]
dt_asmr_in[, Nx := well + sick]

                              population_col = "Nx", disagg_var = "cause")

asmr_cause[, index := ASMR / ASMR_base * 100]

  cause == "ihd",     "Ischemic heart disease",
```

# Program-Attributable Deaths Averted (2017--2050)

```{r compute-deaths-averted, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Core: program-attributable deaths averted --------------------------------
# deaths_averted = deaths(Counterfactual, bau_upper) - deaths(intervention, program)
#
# The counterfactual is ALWAYS "Counterfactual" in rate_scenario == "bau_upper".
# Merging on intervention was wrong for TFA: bau_upper has no "TFA Elimination" rows.

grp_keys <- c("age_group", "sex", "year", "location", "cause", "age")

# Counterfactual deaths: Counterfactual intervention, bau_upper rate scenario
dt_cf <- data_bau[intervention == "Counterfactual" & year >= 2017,
                  .(cf_deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  by = grp_keys]

# Program deaths: all non-Counterfactual interventions, program rate scenario
dt_pgm_agg <- data_program[intervention %in% int_order & year >= 2017,
                            .(pgm_deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                            by = c(grp_keys, "intervention")]

# Merge: each intervention row gets the single counterfactual baseline
dt_merged <- merge(dt_pgm_agg, dt_cf, by = grp_keys, all.x = TRUE)
dt_merged[is.na(cf_deaths),  cf_deaths  := 0]
dt_merged[is.na(pgm_deaths), pgm_deaths := 0]
dt_merged[, deaths_averted := cf_deaths - pgm_deaths]

# ---- Cumulative totals per intervention --------------------------------------
dt_cumul <- dt_merged[, .(deaths_averted = sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
                       by = intervention]

# ---- Annual time-series ------------------------------------------------------
dt_annual <- dt_merged[, .(deaths_averted = sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
                        by = .(intervention, year)]
dt_annual[, intervention := factor(intervention, levels = int_order)]
setorder(dt_annual, intervention, year)
dt_annual[, cum_deaths_averted := cumsum(deaths_averted), by = intervention]

# ---- Per-scenario totals for inline text ------------------------------------
total_combined <- dt_cumul[intervention == "HTN Control + TFA Elimination", deaths_averted]
total_bp       <- dt_cumul[intervention == "HTN Control (Program)",         deaths_averted]
total_tfa      <- dt_cumul[intervention == "TFA Elimination",               deaths_averted]

n_years <- uniqueN(dt_merged$year)
```

```{r per1m-scalars, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# Per-1M scalars for inline narrative (average per-country cumulative per 1M)
lives_per_1M_htn      <- round(total_bp       / n_countries)
lives_per_1M_tfa      <- round(total_tfa      / n_countries)
lives_per_1M_combined <- round(total_combined / n_countries)
```

Between 2017 and 2050, the combined RTSL hypertension control and trans-fat elimination
programs are projected to avert approximately **`r fmt_k(total_combined)` thousand deaths**
(`r fmt_k(lives_per_1M_combined)` thousand per million treated)
across `r n_countries` countries.

- **HTN Control (Program)** alone would avert `r fmt_k(total_bp)` thousand deaths
  (`r fmt_k(lives_per_1M_htn)` thousand per million treated).
- **TFA Elimination** alone would avert `r fmt_k(total_tfa)` thousand deaths
  (`r fmt_k(lives_per_1M_tfa)` thousand per million population).

# Outcomes per 1 Million

```{r per1m-compute, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Reconstruct actual population denominators from raw inputs ----
# Replicating the logic from 05_build_baseline.R (not from model output)

# PROGRAM POPULATION (HTN denominator): actual enrolled per location-year
dt_program_pop <- tryCatch({
  # Step a: Load htn_control_scenarios, keep location, year, enrolled
  htn_csv <- fread(paste0(wd_data, "htn_control_scenarios_by_loc_year.csv"))
  htn_csv <- htn_csv[, .(location, year, enrolled)]

  # Step b: Compute age/sex population proportions from model output
  #         (data_bau, Counterfactual, cause == "ihd", year >= 2017)
  dt_pop_dist <- data_bau[
    intervention == "Counterfactual" & cause == "ihd" & year >= 2017,
    .(population = sum(pop, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = .(location, year, age, sex)
  ]
  dt_pop_dist[, population_proportion := population / sum(population),
              by = .(location, year)]

  # Step c: Merge enrolled x population_proportion to get Nx_program
  dt_enr <- merge(htn_csv, dt_pop_dist,
                  by = c("location", "year"), all.y = TRUE)
  dt_enr[is.na(enrolled), enrolled := 0]
  dt_enr[, Nx_program := enrolled * population_proportion]

  # Step d: Sum by location-year to get total program_population
  dt_enr[, .(program_population = sum(Nx_program, na.rm = TRUE)),
         by = .(location, year)]
}, error = function(e) {
  message("htn_control_scenarios_by_loc_year.csv not found ",
          "\u2014 program_population unavailable.")
  NULL
})

# TOTAL COUNTRY POPULATION age 20+ per location-year
# (from UNWPP, same source as 05_build_baseline.R)
dt_total_pop <- tryCatch({
  # save for reporting estimates in the report
  pop_raw <- readRDS(file = paste0(wd_data,"dt_pop_estimates_output_report.rds"))
  
  # pop_raw <- fread(paste0(wd_data, "PopulationsAge20_2050.csv"))
  if ("year_id" %in% names(pop_raw)) setnames(pop_raw, "year_id", "year")
  pop_raw[, .(total_population = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE)),
          by = .(location, year)]
}, error = function(e) {
  message("PopulationsAge20_2050.csv not found ",
          "\u2014 total_population unavailable.")
  NULL
})

# ---- Per-1M summary by intervention x cause ----
# Model outputs are already per 1M treated (upstream normalisation).
# HTN scenarios: per 1M treated patients
# TFA scenarios: per 1M population (approximately equal per-person rate)

dt_per1m_int_cause <- dt_merged[
  year >= 2017,
  .(deaths_per_1M        = round(sum(pgm_deaths,     na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    deaths_averted_per_1M = round(sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE), 1)),
  by = .(intervention, cause)
]
dt_per1m_int_cause[, cause_lbl := cause_map[cause]]
dt_per1m_int_cause[, denominator := fifelse(
  intervention == "TFA Elimination",
  "per 1M population", "per 1M treated"
)]

# Totals by intervention (for bar chart)
dt_per1m_bar <- dt_merged[
  year >= 2017,
  .(deaths_averted_per_1M = sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = intervention
]
dt_per1m_bar[, intervention := factor(intervention, levels = int_order)]

# ---- Rescale to actual absolute deaths averted ----
dt_rescale_detail <- dt_merged[
  year >= 2017,
  .(per_1M_averted = sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(intervention, location, year)
]

if (!is.null(dt_program_pop)) {
  dt_rescale_detail <- merge(dt_rescale_detail, dt_program_pop,
                             by = c("location", "year"), all.x = TRUE)
} else {
  dt_rescale_detail[, program_population := NA_real_]
}
if (!is.null(dt_total_pop)) {
  dt_rescale_detail <- merge(dt_rescale_detail, dt_total_pop,
                             by = c("location", "year"), all.x = TRUE)
} else {
  dt_rescale_detail[, total_population := NA_real_]
}

# HTN: multiply per-1M by (actual program_population / 1e6)
dt_rescale_detail[
  intervention %in% c("HTN Control (Program)",
                       "HTN Control + TFA Elimination"),
  abs_averted := per_1M_averted * (program_population / 1e6)
]
# TFA: multiply per-1M by (total_population / 1e6)
dt_rescale_detail[
  intervention == "TFA Elimination",
  abs_averted := per_1M_averted * (total_population / 1e6)
]

# Aggregate for comparison table
dt_rescale_agg <- dt_rescale_detail[,
  .(rescaled_abs = sum(abs_averted, na.rm = TRUE),
    model_per_1M = sum(per_1M_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = intervention
]
dt_rescale_agg[, model_per_1M_K  := round(model_per_1M  / 1e3, 1)]
dt_rescale_agg[, rescaled_abs_K  := round(rescaled_abs  / 1e3, 1)]

# Flag large discrepancies (> 10%) between rescaled and model per-1M
# (expected to differ because of population scaling; flag only unexpected mismatches)
dt_rescale_agg[, ratio := rescaled_abs / pmax(model_per_1M, 1)]

# ---- Additional per-1M scalars for narrative ----
# (lives_per_1M_htn/tfa/combined already computed in per1m-scalars chunk)

# 5-year window (2020-2024) average per country
lives_per_1M_htn_5yr <- round(
  dt_merged[intervention == "HTN Control (Program)" &
              year %in% 2020:2024,
            sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)] / n_countries
)

# Rescaled absolute totals
total_bp_rescaled <- sum(
  dt_rescale_detail[intervention == "HTN Control (Program)",
                    abs_averted], na.rm = TRUE)
total_tfa_rescaled <- sum(
  dt_rescale_detail[intervention == "TFA Elimination",
                    abs_averted], na.rm = TRUE)
total_combined_rescaled <- sum(
  dt_rescale_detail[intervention == "HTN Control + TFA Elimination",
                    abs_averted], na.rm = TRUE)
```

## Narrative Summary

The RTSL HTN program is projected to save approximately
`r fmt_k(lives_per_1M_htn)` thousand lives per million patients treated
(cumulative `r study_years`), equivalent to
`r fmt_k(total_bp_rescaled)` thousand deaths averted across all
`r n_countries` program countries. Over a 5-year window (2020--2024),
the average program country averts `r fmt_k(lives_per_1M_htn_5yr)` thousand
deaths per million treated.

TFA elimination policies are projected to avert
`r fmt_k(lives_per_1M_tfa)` thousand deaths per million population
(cumulative), rescaling to `r fmt_k(total_tfa_rescaled)` thousand actual
deaths averted across program countries.

Combined, `r fmt_k(lives_per_1M_combined)` thousand deaths per million
treated are averted, equivalent to `r fmt_k(total_combined_rescaled)` thousand
deaths averted in absolute terms.

## Table 3 --- Deaths Averted by Age Group and Intervention

```{r table3-age, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# Build age-group summary using program vs bau comparison
dt_tab3_base <- data_bau[year >= 2017 & intervention %in% int_order,
                          .(baseline_deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                          by = .(age_group, intervention)]
dt_tab3_pgm  <- data_program[year >= 2017 & intervention %in% int_order,
                              .(pgm_deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                              by = .(age_group, intervention)]

dt_tab3 <- merge(dt_tab3_pgm, dt_tab3_base,
                 by = c("age_group", "intervention"), all = TRUE)
dt_tab3[, deaths_averted    := baseline_deaths - pgm_deaths]
dt_tab3[, deaths_averted_yr := deaths_averted / n_years]
dt_tab3[, pct_averted       := deaths_averted / baseline_deaths]

dt_tab3[, intervention := factor(intervention, levels = int_order)]
setorder(dt_tab3, age_group, intervention)

dt_tab3_fmt <- dt_tab3[, .(
  Age_group          = age_group,
  Intervention       = intervention,
  Counterfactual     = comma(baseline_deaths,   accuracy = 1),
  Program            = comma(pgm_deaths,        accuracy = 1),
  Deaths_averted     = comma(deaths_averted,    accuracy = 1),
  Deaths_averted_yr  = comma(deaths_averted_yr, accuracy = 1),
  Pct_averted        = percent(pct_averted, accuracy = 0.1)
)]
setnames(dt_tab3_fmt,
         old = c("Age_group", "Counterfactual", "Program",
                 "Deaths_averted", "Deaths_averted_yr", "Pct_averted"),
         new = c("Age group", "Counterfactual deaths", "Program deaths",
                 "Deaths averted", "Deaths averted/year", "% averted"))

kable(dt_tab3_fmt,
      caption = "Table 3. Deaths averted (2017\u20132050) by age group and intervention.",
```

```{r figure6-map, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=5}
wpp <- tryCatch(

  ]
```

```{r asmr-interventions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
# Compute ASMR for program and counterfactual runs (combined intervention = HTN+TFA)
dt_asmr_pgm <- data_program[
  intervention == "HTN Control + TFA Elimination" & year >= 2017,
  .(dead = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE),
    well = sum(well, na.rm = TRUE),
    sick = sum(sick, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(age, year)]
dt_asmr_pgm[, Nx := well + sick]
dt_asmr_pgm[, scenario := "Program (HTN + TFA)"]

dt_asmr_bau <- data_bau[
  intervention == "HTN Control + TFA Elimination" & year >= 2017,
  .(dead = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE),
    well = sum(well, na.rm = TRUE),
    sick = sum(sick, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(age, year)]
dt_asmr_bau[, Nx := well + sick]
dt_asmr_bau[, scenario := "Counterfactual"]

dt_asmr_both <- rbind(dt_asmr_pgm, dt_asmr_bau)
asmr_int <- calculate_asmr(dt_asmr_both, deaths_col = "dead",
                            population_col = "Nx", disagg_var = "scenario")

g <- ggplot(asmr_int,
            aes(x = year, y = ASMR, color = scenario, linetype = year > 2024)) +
```

```{r premature-mortality, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
dt_u70 <- dt_merged[intervention %in% int_order & age_group == "<70",
                     .(deaths_averted = sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
                     by = .(intervention, sex)]

dt_u70_total <- dt_merged[intervention == "HTN Control + TFA Elimination" &
                            age_group == "<70",
                          .(deaths_averted_u70 = sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
                          by = location]

dt_u70_all <- dt_merged[intervention == "HTN Control + TFA Elimination",
                         .(deaths_averted_total = sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
                         by = location]

dt_u70_loc <- merge(dt_u70_total, dt_u70_all, by = "location")
dt_u70_loc[, prop_u70 := fifelse(deaths_averted_total == 0, NA_real_,
                                  deaths_averted_u70 / deaths_averted_total)]
setorder(dt_u70_loc, -deaths_averted_u70)
```

# Excel Export

```{r excel-export, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
wb <- createWorkbook()

add_sheet <- function(wb, sheet_name, dat, title_str) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, title_str, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
  addStyle(wb, sheet_name,
           style = createStyle(fontSize = 12, textDecoration = "bold"),
           rows = 1, cols = 1)
  writeData(wb, sheet_name, dat, startRow = 3, startCol = 1,
            headerStyle = createStyle(textDecoration = "bold",
                                      fgFill = "#2E75B6", fontColour = "white",
                                      border = "Bottom"))
  setColWidths(wb, sheet_name, cols = seq_len(ncol(dat)), widths = "auto")
}

add_sheet(wb, "T1_Deaths_by_Intervention", as.data.frame(dt_excel_tab1),
          "Table 1. Program-attributable deaths averted (2017-2050) by intervention.")
add_sheet(wb, "T2_Deaths_by_Cause", as.data.frame(dt_excel_tab2),
          "Table 2. Deaths averted (thousands) by intervention and cause of death.")
add_sheet(wb, "T3_Deaths_by_Age", as.data.frame(dt_excel_tab3),
          "Table 3. Deaths averted by age group and intervention.")
add_sheet(wb, "T4_Deaths_by_Country", as.data.frame(dt_excel_tab4),
          "Table 4. Country-level deaths averted (HTN + TFA, 2017-2050).")

if (exists("dt_excel_tab5") && nrow(dt_excel_tab5) > 0)
  add_sheet(wb, "T5_Deaths_by_Region", as.data.frame(dt_excel_tab5),
            "Table 5. Deaths averted by region (HTN + TFA, 2017-2050).")

add_sheet(wb, "Countries", as.data.frame(countries_by_region),
          "Countries included in the assessment, by region.")

# Premature mortality
if (exists("dt_u70_loc") && nrow(dt_u70_loc) > 0)
  add_sheet(wb, "U70_by_Country", as.data.frame(dt_u70_loc),
            "Deaths averted under age 70 by country (HTN + TFA, 2017-2050).")

# ---- Per1M_Summary sheet ----
# One row per location x year x scenario, all scenarios stacked
dt_cf_ly <- data_bau[
  intervention == "Counterfactual" & year >= 2017,
  .(deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(location, year)
]
dt_cf_ly[, scenario := "Counterfactual"]

dt_int_ly <- dt_merged[
  year >= 2017,
  .(deaths         = sum(pgm_deaths,     na.rm = TRUE),
    deaths_averted = sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(location, year, intervention)
]
setnames(dt_int_ly, "intervention", "scenario")

# Counterfactual deaths reference (for pct_averted)
dt_cf_ref_ly <- dt_cf_ly[, .(location, year, cf_deaths_ref = deaths)]

dt_excel_per1m <- rbind(
  dt_cf_ly[, .(location, year, scenario, deaths, deaths_averted = 0)],
  dt_int_ly[, .(location, year, scenario, deaths, deaths_averted)],
  fill = TRUE
)
dt_excel_per1m <- merge(dt_excel_per1m, dt_cf_ref_ly,
                        by = c("location", "year"), all.x = TRUE)

# Add population denominators
if (!is.null(dt_total_pop)) {
  dt_excel_per1m <- merge(dt_excel_per1m, dt_total_pop,
                          by = c("location", "year"), all.x = TRUE)
} else {
  dt_excel_per1m[, total_population := NA_real_]
}

if (!is.null(dt_program_pop)) {
  dt_excel_per1m <- merge(dt_excel_per1m, dt_program_pop,
                          by = c("location", "year"), all.x = TRUE)
} else {
  dt_excel_per1m[, program_population := NA_real_]
}

# For TFA and Counterfactual: program_population = total_population
dt_excel_per1m[
  scenario %in% c("TFA Elimination", "Counterfactual"),
  program_population := total_population
]

# Rename total_population -> population
setnames(dt_excel_per1m, "total_population", "population")

# Compute per-1M columns (model output is already per 1M; values are direct)
dt_excel_per1m[, deaths_per_1M         := round(deaths, 1)]
dt_excel_per1m[, deaths_averted_per_1M := round(deaths_averted, 1)]
dt_excel_per1m[scenario == "Counterfactual", deaths_averted_per_1M := 0]

# Absolute deaths averted (rescaled)
dt_excel_per1m[
  scenario %in% c("HTN Control (Program)",
                   "HTN Control + TFA Elimination"),
  n_deaths_averted := deaths_averted * (program_population / 1e6)
]
dt_excel_per1m[
  scenario == "TFA Elimination",
  n_deaths_averted := deaths_averted * (population / 1e6)
]
dt_excel_per1m[scenario == "Counterfactual", n_deaths_averted := 0]

# pct_averted
dt_excel_per1m[, pct_averted := round(
  fifelse(cf_deaths_ref > 0 & scenario != "Counterfactual",
          deaths_averted / cf_deaths_ref * 100, 0), 2)]
dt_excel_per1m[scenario == "Counterfactual", pct_averted := 0]

# Assigne deaths averted per 1M and pct averted to 0 for any rows where population denominator is 0
dt_excel_per1m[program_population == 0, `:=`(
  deaths_averted_per_1M = 0,
  pct_averted = 0
)]


# Select final columns and sort
dt_excel_per1m_final <- dt_excel_per1m[, .(
  location, year, scenario, population, program_population,
  deaths_per_1M, deaths_averted_per_1M, n_deaths_averted, pct_averted
)]
setorder(dt_excel_per1m_final, location, scenario, year)

add_sheet(wb, "Per1M_Summary", as.data.frame(dt_excel_per1m_final),
          "Per 1M Summary: deaths and deaths averted by location, year, and scenario.")

out_xlsx <- paste0(wd_scen, "RTSL_Assessment_Results.xlsx")
saveWorkbook(wb, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)
message("Tables exported to: ", out_xlsx)
```

```{r pareto-charts, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# ---- Pareto Charts: Top 20 Countries by Deaths Averted ----------------------

# Helper: build a top-20 + "Rest of countries" summary with cumulative %
pareto_top20 <- function(dt, scenario_filter) {
  dt_agg <- dt[scenario == scenario_filter,
               .(deaths_averted = sum(n_deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
               by = location]
  setorder(dt_agg, -deaths_averted)

  top20 <- head(dt_agg, 20)
  rest  <- dt_agg[!location %in% top20$location,
                  .(location = "Rest of countries",
                    deaths_averted = sum(deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE))]
  
  out <- rbind(top20, rest, fill = TRUE)
  setorder(out, -deaths_averted)

  out[, cum_deaths := cumsum(deaths_averted)]
  out[, cum_pct := cum_deaths / sum(deaths_averted)]
  out[, location := factor(location, levels = location)]
  
  out
}

# Helper: make a Pareto plot
make_pareto_plot <- function(dt_pareto, fill_color, title_text) {
  y_max <- max(dt_pareto$deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)

  ggplot(dt_pareto, aes(x = location)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = deaths_averted), fill = fill_color) +
    geom_line(aes(y = cum_pct * y_max, group = 1), linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(aes(y = cum_pct * y_max), size = 2) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::comma,
      name   = "Deaths Averted (2017–2050)",
      sec.axis = sec_axis(
        ~ . / y_max,
        name   = "Cumulative percentage",
        labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
      )
    ) +
    labs(x = "Country", title = title_text) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

# --- 1. HTN Control Pareto ---
dt_pareto_htn <- pareto_top20(dt_excel_per1m_final, "HTN Control (Program)")

p_pareto_htn <- make_pareto_plot(
  dt_pareto = dt_pareto_htn,
  fill_color = int_cols["HTN Control (Program)"],
  title_text = "HTN Control: Top 20 Countries by Deaths Averted"
)

# --- 2. TFA Elimination Pareto ---
dt_pareto_tfa <- pareto_top20(dt_excel_per1m_final, "TFA Elimination")

p_pareto_tfa <- make_pareto_plot(
  dt_pareto = dt_pareto_tfa,
  fill_color = int_cols["TFA Elimination"],
  title_text = "TFA Elimination: Top 20 Countries by Deaths Averted"
)

# --- 3. Combined Pareto (HTN + TFA summed by country) ---
# Sum HTN and TFA separately per country (do NOT use the combined scenario row)
dt_htn_by_loc <- dt_excel_per1m_final[
  scenario == "HTN Control (Program)",
  .(htn = sum(n_deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = location
]

dt_tfa_by_loc <- dt_excel_per1m_final[
  scenario == "TFA Elimination",
  .(tfa = sum(n_deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = location
]

dt_combined <- merge(dt_htn_by_loc, dt_tfa_by_loc, by = "location", all = TRUE)
dt_combined[is.na(htn), htn := 0]
dt_combined[is.na(tfa), tfa := 0]
dt_combined[, deaths_averted := htn + tfa]
setorder(dt_combined, -deaths_averted)

top20 <- head(dt_combined, 20)
rest  <- dt_combined[!location %in% top20$location,
                     .(location = "Rest of countries",
                       htn = sum(htn),
                       tfa = sum(tfa),
                       deaths_averted = sum(deaths_averted))]
dt_pareto_combined <- rbind(top20, rest, fill = TRUE)
setorder(dt_pareto_combined, -deaths_averted)

dt_pareto_combined[, cum_deaths := cumsum(deaths_averted)]
dt_pareto_combined[, cum_pct := cum_deaths / sum(deaths_averted)]
dt_pareto_combined[, location := factor(location, levels = location)]

p_pareto_combined <- make_pareto_plot(
  dt_pareto = dt_pareto_combined,
  fill_color = "grey60",
  title_text = "Combined Interventions: Top 20 Countries by Deaths Averted"
)

# Save plot objects for presentation_donors.Rmd
saveRDS(p_pareto_htn,      paste0(slides_dir, "sl_pareto_htn.rds"))
saveRDS(p_pareto_tfa,      paste0(slides_dir, "sl_pareto_tfa.rds"))
saveRDS(p_pareto_combined, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_pareto_combined.rds"))
message("Pareto chart objects saved to slides directory.")
```

```{r slides-bangladesh, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Bangladesh country case artefact for presentation ---------------------
bgd_rds <- paste0(wd_outp, "out_model/model_output_Bangladesh_program_impact.rds")
if (file.exists(bgd_rds)) {
  dt_bgd <- setDT(readRDS(bgd_rds))

  # Program-attributable deaths by scenario
  dt_bgd_pgm <- dt_bgd[rate_scenario == "program" & year >= 2017,
                         .(pgm_deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                         by = .(scenario, year)]
  dt_bgd_cf  <- dt_bgd[rate_scenario == "bau_upper" &
                         scenario == "baseline" & year >= 2017,
                         .(cf_deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                         by = year]

  dt_bgd_merge <- merge(dt_bgd_pgm, dt_bgd_cf, by = "year")
  dt_bgd_merge[, averted := cf_deaths - pgm_deaths]

  # Summary table: total averted by scenario
  sl_bgd_summary <- dt_bgd_merge[, .(total_averted = sum(averted)), by = scenario]

  # Annual time-series for Bangladesh
  sl_bgd_annual <- dt_bgd_merge[, .(year, scenario, averted)]
  sl_bgd_annual[, cum_averted := cumsum(averted), by = scenario]

  # By cause
  dt_bgd_cause_pgm <- dt_bgd[rate_scenario == "program" & year >= 2017,
                               .(pgm_deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                               by = .(scenario, cause)]
  dt_bgd_cause_cf  <- dt_bgd[rate_scenario == "bau_upper" &
                               scenario == "baseline" & year >= 2017,
                               .(cf_deaths = sum(dead, na.rm = TRUE)),
                               by = cause]
  sl_bgd_cause <- merge(dt_bgd_cause_pgm, dt_bgd_cause_cf, by = "cause")
  sl_bgd_cause[, averted := cf_deaths - pgm_deaths]

  sl_bangladesh <- list(
    summary = sl_bgd_summary,
    annual  = sl_bgd_annual,
    cause   = sl_bgd_cause
  )
  saveRDS(sl_bangladesh, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_bangladesh.rds"))
  message("SL-10 saved: sl_bangladesh.rds")
} else {
  message("Bangladesh model output not found — skipping sl_bangladesh.rds")
}
```

```{r sl-fig-htn-control-rates, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- A1: fig_htn_control_rates — Observed (2017–2025) vs Projected (2026–2050) ----
# Source: htn_scenarios (loaded earlier from htn_control_scenarios_by_loc_year.csv)
# Highlights: China, Ecuador, Bangladesh
library(ggrepel)

if (!is.null(htn_scenarios)) {
  dt_htn_cr <- htn_scenarios[year <= 2050,
    .(location, year,
      control_rate = control_rate_program,
      observed     = control_rate_observed)]

  highlight_countries <- c("China", "Ecuador", "Bangladesh")

  # Build a period column: Historical (2017–2025) vs Projected (2026–2050)
  # For the line we need continuous connection, so we duplicate 2025 into both periods
  dt_hist <- dt_htn_cr[year <= 2025]
  dt_hist[, period := "Observed (2017-2025)"]
  dt_proj <- dt_htn_cr[year >= 2025]
  dt_proj[, period := "Projected (2026-2050)"]
  dt_all <- rbind(dt_hist, dt_proj)

  # Highlight vs background

  dt_all[, highlighted := location %in% highlight_countries]
  dt_all[, alpha_val := fifelse(highlighted, 1.0, 0.3)]
  dt_all[, size_val  := fifelse(highlighted, 0.9, 0.4)]

  # Labels at rightmost point for highlighted countries
  dt_labels <- dt_all[highlighted == TRUE & year == max(year),
                       .(location, year, control_rate, period)]
  dt_labels <- unique(dt_labels, by = "location")

  fig_htn_control_rates <- ggplot(dt_all,
         aes(x = year, y = control_rate * 100, group = interaction(location, period))) +
    # Background countries
    geom_line(data = dt_all[highlighted == FALSE],
              aes(color = period, linetype = period),
              linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = dt_all[highlighted == FALSE & observed == 1],
               aes(x = year, y = control_rate * 100),
               color = "grey60", size = 0.5, alpha = 0.3) +
    # Highlighted countries
    geom_line(data = dt_all[highlighted == TRUE],
              aes(color = period, linetype = period),
              linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 1.0) +
    geom_point(data = dt_all[highlighted == TRUE & observed == 1],
               aes(x = year, y = control_rate * 100),
               color = "#2171B5", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.9) +
    # Country labels for highlighted
    geom_label_repel(data = dt_labels,
                     aes(x = year, y = control_rate * 100, label = location),
                     size = 2.5, nudge_x = 1, segment.size = 0.3,
                     fontface = "bold", fill = "white", label.size = 0.2,
                     inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = NULL,
      values = c("Observed (2017-2025)" = "#2171B5",
                 "Projected (2026-2050)" = "#D4880F"),
      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1, alpha = 1))
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = NULL,
      values = c("Observed (2017-2025)" = "solid",
                 "Projected (2026-2050)" = "dashed")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2017, 2050, 5),
                       limits = c(2017, 2054), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = "Observed and Projected Hypertension Program Control Rates",
      x = "Year", y = "Control Rate (%)",
      caption = "Dots = observed; lines = projected at 2024 level (2026-2050). China, Ecuador, and Bangladesh highlighted."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0))

  saveRDS(fig_htn_control_rates, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_fig_htn_control_rates.rds"))
  message("SL-A1 saved: sl_fig_htn_control_rates.rds")
} else {
  fig_htn_control_rates <- NULL
  message("htn_scenarios not available — skipping fig_htn_control_rates")
}
```

```{r sl-tbl-tfa-countries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- A2: tbl_tfa_countries — TFA policy table, RTSL-engaged countries only ----

  as.data.table(readRDS(paste0(wd_data, "tfa_policy_scenarios_assessment.rds"))),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (!is.null(dt_tfa_scenarios)) {
  # Inspect actual column names (logged for verification)
  message("TFA scenario columns: ", paste(names(dt_tfa_scenarios), collapse = ", "))

  # CRITICAL FILTER: keep only RTSL-engaged countries (case-insensitive)
  dt_tfa_pol <- dt_tfa_scenarios[
    !is.na(tfa_bpp_date_passed) &
    tolower(tfa_rtsl_engagement) == "yes"
  ]

  # One row per country: earliest record (policy establishment)
  dt_tfa_pol <- dt_tfa_pol[, .(
    `Year Established` = as.integer(min(tfa_bpp_date_passed, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `Year in Effect`   = as.integer(min(tfa_bpp_date_in_effect, na.rm = TRUE)),
    `RTSL Engaged`     = "Yes"
  ), by = .(Country = location)]

  # Sort by year established ascending
  setorder(dt_tfa_pol, `Year Established`)

  tbl_tfa_countries <- dt_tfa_pol
  saveRDS(tbl_tfa_countries, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_tbl_tfa_countries.rds"))
  message("SL-A2 saved: sl_tbl_tfa_countries.rds")
} else {
  tbl_tfa_countries <- NULL
  message("tfa_policy_scenarios_assessment.rds not found — skipping tbl_tfa_countries")
}
```

```{r sl-tbl-htn-program-vs-country, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- A3: tbl_htn_program_vs_country — Program vs National Control Rate ----
# Source: htn_control_scenarios_by_loc_year.csv
# Columns used: location, year, control_rate_program, htncov2
if (!is.null(htn_scenarios)) {
  message("HTN scenario columns: ", paste(names(htn_scenarios), collapse = ", "))

  # Keep rows where both control_rate_program and htncov2 are available
  dt_htn_compare <- htn_scenarios[
    !is.na(control_rate_program) & !is.na(htncov2),
    .(location, year, htncov2, control_rate_program)
  ]

  # Use most recent available year per country
  dt_htn_compare[, max_year := max(year), by = location]
  dt_htn_compare <- dt_htn_compare[year == max_year]
  dt_htn_compare[, max_year := NULL]

  # Compute difference: positive = program outperforms, negative = underperforms
  dt_htn_compare[, program_vs_country_diff := control_rate_program - htncov2]

  # Sort by difference ascending (worst performers first)
  setorder(dt_htn_compare, program_vs_country_diff)

  # Format for display
  dt_htn_compare[, `:=`(
    `National Control Rate` = paste0(round(htncov2 * 100, 1), "%"),
    `Program Control Rate`  = paste0(round(control_rate_program * 100, 1), "%"),
    `Difference (pp)`       = round(program_vs_country_diff * 100, 1)
  )]

  # Identify underperforming rows for highlighting
  underperforming_rows <- which(dt_htn_compare$program_vs_country_diff < 0)

  tbl_htn_program_vs_country <- dt_htn_compare[, .(
    Country = location,
    `National Control Rate`,
    `Program Control Rate`,
    `Difference (pp)`
  )]

  # Store the row indices for highlighting in presentation
  attr(tbl_htn_program_vs_country, "underperforming_rows") <- underperforming_rows

  saveRDS(tbl_htn_program_vs_country, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_tbl_htn_program_vs_country.rds"))
  message("SL-A3 saved: sl_tbl_htn_program_vs_country.rds")
} else {
  tbl_htn_program_vs_country <- NULL
  message("htn_scenarios not available — skipping tbl_htn_program_vs_country")
}
```

```{r sl-tbl-total-lives-saved, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- B1: tbl_total_lives_saved — Absolute total deaths averted by country ----
# Source: dt_excel_per1m (computed above)
# IMPORTANT: HTN uses program_population denominator; TFA uses total country population
# n_deaths_averted is already computed as absolute totals in dt_excel_per1m
if (exists("dt_excel_per1m") && nrow(dt_excel_per1m) > 0) {
  message("dt_excel_per1m columns: ", paste(names(dt_excel_per1m), collapse = ", "))

  # Summarize cumulative absolute deaths averted per country x scenario
  dt_lives <- dt_excel_per1m[
    scenario %in% c("HTN Control (Program)", "TFA Elimination") & year >= 2017,
    .(total_averted = sum(n_deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = .(location, scenario)
  ]

  dt_lives_wide <- dcast(dt_lives, location ~ scenario,
                          value.var = "total_averted", fill = 0)
  # Rename columns for display
  old_names <- names(dt_lives_wide)
  setnames(dt_lives_wide,
           old = old_names,
           new = c("Country", "HTN Deaths Averted", "TFA Deaths Averted"))

  # Do NOT show combined column — populations differ
  # Sort by HTN deaths averted descending
  setorder(dt_lives_wide, -`HTN Deaths Averted`)

  # Format with comma separators
  dt_lives_wide[, `HTN Deaths Averted` := formatC(round(`HTN Deaths Averted`),
                                                    format = "d", big.mark = ",")]
  dt_lives_wide[, `TFA Deaths Averted` := formatC(round(`TFA Deaths Averted`),
                                                    format = "d", big.mark = ",")]

  tbl_total_lives_saved <- dt_lives_wide
  saveRDS(tbl_total_lives_saved, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_tbl_total_lives_saved.rds"))
  message("SL-B1 saved: sl_tbl_total_lives_saved.rds")
} else {
  tbl_total_lives_saved <- NULL
  message("dt_excel_per1m not available — skipping tbl_total_lives_saved")
}
```

```{r sl-fig-global-cumulative, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- B5: fig_global_cumulative — Stacked area: cumulative deaths averted, all countries ----
# Source: dt_excel_per1m, aggregated across ALL countries, time preserved
# HTN uses n_deaths_averted (program pop); TFA uses n_deaths_averted (total pop)
# n_deaths_averted already applies the correct population denominator per intervention
if (exists("dt_excel_per1m") && nrow(dt_excel_per1m) > 0) {
  # Aggregate absolute deaths averted across all countries by year and scenario
  dt_global_ts <- dt_excel_per1m[
    scenario %in% c("HTN Control (Program)", "TFA Elimination") & year >= 2017,
    .(n_deaths_averted = sum(n_deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = .(year, scenario)
  ]

  # Compute cumulative over time by scenario
  setorder(dt_global_ts, scenario, year)
  dt_global_ts[, cum_averted := cumsum(n_deaths_averted), by = scenario]

  # Display labels
  dt_global_ts[, intervention := fifelse(
    scenario == "HTN Control (Program)",
    "Hypertension Control", "TFA Elimination"
  )]

  # Grand total at final year for annotation
  max_year_global <- max(dt_global_ts$year)
  grand_total_global <- dt_global_ts[year == max_year_global, sum(cum_averted, na.rm = TRUE)]
  # Per-intervention totals at final year for inline use
  global_cum_htn <- dt_global_ts[year == max_year_global & scenario == "HTN Control (Program)", cum_averted]
  global_cum_tfa <- dt_global_ts[year == max_year_global & scenario == "TFA Elimination", cum_averted]

  fig_global_cumulative <- ggplot(dt_global_ts,
         aes(x = year, y = cum_averted, fill = intervention)) +
    geom_area(alpha = 0.8, position = "stack") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("Hypertension Control" = "#2171B5",
                 "TFA Elimination"      = "#E31A1C"),
      name = "Intervention"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2017, 2050, 5)) +
    annotate("text", x = max_year_global, y = grand_total_global,
             label = paste0("Total: ", formatC(round(grand_total_global),
                            format = "d", big.mark = ",")),
             hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(
      title = "Cumulative Deaths Averted Over Time — All Countries",
      x = "Year", y = "Cumulative Deaths Averted",
      caption = "Cumulative deaths averted by intervention, all RTSL-engaged countries, 2024-2050.\nHTN reflects program population; TFA reflects national population."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0))

  # Store per-intervention totals for inline use in presentation
  attr(fig_global_cumulative, "global_cum_htn") <- global_cum_htn
  attr(fig_global_cumulative, "global_cum_tfa") <- global_cum_tfa
  attr(fig_global_cumulative, "grand_total") <- grand_total_global

  saveRDS(fig_global_cumulative, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_fig_global_cumulative.rds"))
  message("SL-B5 saved: sl_fig_global_cumulative.rds")
} else {
  fig_global_cumulative <- NULL
  message("dt_excel_per1m not available — skipping fig_global_cumulative")
}
```

```{r sl-fig-tfa-timeline, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# ---- TFA Ban Implementation Timeline (bar + line, dual y-axes) ----
# Uses dt_tfa_scenarios loaded earlier in sl-tbl-tfa-countries chunk
# and population data from PopulationsSingleAge0050.rds

sl_fig_tfa_timeline <- NULL

if (exists("dt_tfa_scenarios") && !is.null(dt_tfa_scenarios)) {

  # One row per country: earliest date_passed, plus tfa_rtsl_include flag
  dt_tfa_timeline <- dt_tfa_scenarios[
    !is.na(tfa_bpp_date_passed),
    .(year_passed    = as.integer(min(tfa_bpp_date_passed, na.rm = TRUE)),
      tfa_rtsl_include = first(tfa_rtsl_include)),
    by = .(location)
  ]

  # Load population for cumulative coverage line
  wpp_tfa <- tryCatch(
    as.data.table(readRDS(paste0(wd_data, "PopulationsSingleAge0050.rds"))),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (!is.null(wpp_tfa)) {
    pop_total <- wpp_tfa[year_id == 2024, .(pop = sum(Nx, na.rm = TRUE)), by = location]
    dt_tfa_timeline <- merge(dt_tfa_timeline, pop_total, by = "location", all.x = TRUE)
    dt_tfa_timeline[is.na(pop), pop := 0]
  } else {
    dt_tfa_timeline[, pop := 0]
  }

  # Build cumulative counts by year
  year_range <- seq(min(dt_tfa_timeline$year_passed), max(dt_tfa_timeline$year_passed))

  dt_cumul_tfa <- rbindlist(lapply(year_range, function(yr) {
    passed <- dt_tfa_timeline[year_passed <= yr]
    data.table(
      year = yr,
      n_rtsl_include_yes = nrow(passed[tolower(tfa_rtsl_include) == "yes"]),
      n_rtsl_include_no  = nrow(passed[tolower(tfa_rtsl_include) == "no"]),
      cum_pop            = sum(passed$pop, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  }))

  dt_cumul_tfa[, n_total := n_rtsl_include_yes + n_rtsl_include_no]
  dt_cumul_tfa[, cum_pop_b := cum_pop / 1e9]

  # Melt for stacked bars
  dt_bar <- melt(dt_cumul_tfa, id.vars = c("year", "n_total", "cum_pop_b"),
                 measure.vars = c("n_rtsl_include_yes", "n_rtsl_include_no"),
                 variable.name = "category", value.name = "n_countries")
  dt_bar[, category := fifelse(category == "n_rtsl_include_yes",
                                "RTSL Assessment",
                                "Other Countries")]
  dt_bar[, category := factor(category, levels = c("Other Countries", "RTSL Assessment"))]

  # Scaling factor for dual y-axis: map population to country-count scale
  max_countries <- max(dt_cumul_tfa$n_total)
  max_pop_b     <- max(dt_cumul_tfa$cum_pop_b)
  scale_factor  <- max_countries / max_pop_b

  # After line 2632, add:
  dt_cumul_tfa[, cum_pop_scaled := cum_pop_b * scale_factor]

  scale_factor <- max_countries / max_pop_b

# Build sec_axis using a formula with the literal value substituted in
sec_axis_formula <- substitute(~ . / sf, list(sf = scale_factor))

  sl_fig_tfa_timeline <- ggplot() +
    # Stacked bars: cumulative countries
    geom_col(data = dt_bar,
             aes(x = year, y = n_countries, fill = category),
             width = 0.7) +
    # Line: cumulative population (rescaled to country-count axis)
    geom_line(data = dt_cumul_tfa,
              aes(x = year, y = cum_pop_scaled),
              color = "#2c3e50", linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(data = dt_cumul_tfa,
               aes(x = year, y = cum_pop_scaled),
               color = "#2c3e50", size = 2.5) +
    # Data labels: cumulative country count on top of bars
    geom_text(data = dt_cumul_tfa,
              aes(x = year, y = n_total, label = n_total),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
    # WHO REPLACE annotation
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2018, linetype = "dashed", color = "#c0392b",
               linewidth = 0.7) +
    annotate("text", x = 2018.15, y = max_countries * 0.92,
             label = "WHO REPLACE\nInitiative (2018)",
             hjust = 0, size = 3.2, color = "#c0392b", fontface = "italic") +
    # Scales
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("RTSL Assessment"  = "#1f78b4",
                 "Other Countries"   = "#a6cee3"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_range,
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name   = "Cumulative Number of Countries",
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(
  trans = as.formula(sec_axis_formula),
  name  = "Cumulative Population Covered (billions)"
)
    ) +
    labs(
      title   = "Trans Fat Elimination: Global Best-Practice Policy Adoption",
      subtitle = "Cumulative countries with TFA bans and population covered over time",
      x       = "Year of Policy Passage",
      caption = "Population: UNWPP 2024 total population. Line = cumulative population covered."
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 11),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "top",
      legend.justification = "left",
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#2c3e50"),
      axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "#2c3e50"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )

  print(sl_fig_tfa_timeline)
  saveRDS(sl_fig_tfa_timeline, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_fig_tfa_timeline.rds"))
  ggsave(paste0(wd_outp, "assessment_tfa_timeline.png"), plot = sl_fig_tfa_timeline,
         width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  message("SL-NEW saved: sl_fig_tfa_timeline.rds")
} else {
  message("dt_tfa_scenarios not available — skipping TFA timeline plot")
}
```

```{r sl-fig-country-map, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# ---- World Map: Country Coverage (HTN Program, TFA Ban, Both) ----
# HTN program countries: from data_program (unique locations)
# TFA ban countries: from dt_tfa_scenarios (countries with tfa_bpp_date_passed)
# Engagement: tfa_rtsl_engagement

sl_fig_country_map <- NULL

program_countries <- unique(data_program[intervention %in% int_order, location])

dt_htn_control_scenarios <- fread(paste0(wd_data, "htn_control_scenarios_by_loc_year.csv"))
htn_countries <- unique(dt_htn_control_scenarios$location)


if (exists("dt_tfa_scenarios") && !is.null(dt_tfa_scenarios)) {

  # TFA countries with a ban (date_passed is not NA) that are in RTSL assessment
  dt_tfa_map <- dt_tfa_scenarios[
    !is.na(tfa_bpp_date_passed),
    .(tfa_rtsl_engagement = first(tfa_rtsl_engagement)),
    by = .(location)
  ]
  tfa_countries <- dt_tfa_map$location

  # Build classification
  dt_class <- data.table(
    location = union(htn_countries, tfa_countries)
  )
  dt_class[, has_htn := location %in% htn_countries]
  dt_class[, has_tfa := location %in% tfa_countries]

  # Merge engagement info
  dt_class <- merge(dt_class, dt_tfa_map, by = "location", all.x = TRUE)

  dt_class[, coverage := fcase(
    has_htn & has_tfa, "HTN Program + TFA Ban",
    has_htn & !has_tfa, "HTN Program Only",
    !has_htn & has_tfa & tolower(tfa_rtsl_engagement) == "yes",
      "TFA Ban Only",
    default = NA_character_
  )]

  dt_class[is.na(coverage) & has_tfa & !is.na(tfa_rtsl_engagement), coverage := "TFA Ban Only"]
  
  # Remove countries that don't match any display category
  dt_class <- dt_class[!is.na(coverage)]
  
  # remove countries not counted in TF not HTN program, eg USA
  dt_class <- dt_class[location %in% program_countries,]

  # Merge with ISO3 codes for map join
  dt_class_iso <- merge(dt_class, countries_dt[, .(location, iso3)],
                         by = "location", all.x = TRUE)

  # Load world map
  world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

  world_map <- merge(world, dt_class_iso[, .(iso3, coverage)],
                     by.x = "adm0_a3", by.y = "iso3", all.x = TRUE)

  # Color palette
  coverage_cols <- c(
    "HTN Program + TFA Ban"         = "#6a3d9a",
    "HTN Program Only"              = "#1f78b4",
    "TFA Ban Only"   = "#e31a1c"
  )

  sl_fig_country_map <- ggplot(world_map) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = coverage), color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.15) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values   = coverage_cols,
      na.value = "grey90",
      name     = "Intervention Coverage",
      na.translate = FALSE
    ) +
    coord_sf(crs = "+proj=robin") +
    labs(
      title    = "Global Coverage: HTN and TFA Interventions",
      subtitle = "Countries with RTSL-associated hypertension programs and/or TFA best-practice policies",
      caption  = "Source: RTSL program data and WHO TFA policy tracker"
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 11),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title  = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
      plot.margin   = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

  print(sl_fig_country_map)
  saveRDS(sl_fig_country_map, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_fig_country_map.rds"))
  ggsave(paste0(wd_outp, "assessment_country_map.png"), plot = sl_fig_country_map,
         width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
  message("SL-NEW saved: sl_fig_country_map.rds")
} else {
  message("dt_tfa_scenarios not available — skipping country map")
}
```

     PARTNERS & DONORS PRESENTATION ARTEFACTS
     All computations for presentation_cvh_partners_donors.Rmd live here.

```{r pd-combined-country, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Per-country combined deaths averted (HTN + TFA summed by country) ------
# HTN and TFA are filtered separately (different target populations) then
# summed at the country level to produce the combined total used throughout
# the donors/partners presentation.
dt_pd_htn <- dt_excel_per1m[
  scenario == "HTN Control (Program)" & year >= 2017,
  .(htn_averted = sum(n_deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = location
]
dt_pd_tfa <- dt_excel_per1m[
  scenario == "TFA Elimination" & year >= 2017,
  .(tfa_averted = sum(n_deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = location
]
dt_pd_country <- merge(dt_pd_htn, dt_pd_tfa, by = "location", all = TRUE)
dt_pd_country[is.na(htn_averted), htn_averted := 0]
dt_pd_country[is.na(tfa_averted), tfa_averted := 0]
dt_pd_country[, combined_averted := htn_averted + tfa_averted]

# Attach region metadata
dt_pd_country <- merge(dt_pd_country, countries_dt[, .(location, region)],
                       by = "location", all.x = TRUE)
setorder(dt_pd_country, -combined_averted)

saveRDS(dt_pd_country, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_pd_country_combined.rds"))
message("PD saved: sl_pd_country_combined.rds")
```

```{r pd-annual-combined, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Global annual combined deaths averted (HTN + TFA, sum over countries) --
dt_pd_annual <- dt_excel_per1m[
  scenario %in% c("HTN Control (Program)", "TFA Elimination") & year >= 2017,
  .(deaths_averted = sum(n_deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = year
]
setorder(dt_pd_annual, year)
dt_pd_annual[, cum_averted := cumsum(deaths_averted)]

# Cumulative-deaths-averted chart used in place of the HTN-vs-TFA stacked area
fig_pd_global_cumulative <- ggplot(dt_pd_annual,
       aes(x = year, y = cum_averted)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.85, fill = "#4B2E83") +
  geom_line(color = "#4B2E83", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2017, 2050, 5)) +
  annotate("text",
           x = max(dt_pd_annual$year),
           y = max(dt_pd_annual$cum_averted),
           label = paste0("Total: ",
                          formatC(round(max(dt_pd_annual$cum_averted)),
                                  format = "d", big.mark = ",")),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 1.3, size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Deaths Averted: RTSL CVH Programs",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Cumulative deaths averted",
    caption = "Combined hypertension control and trans-fat elimination across RTSL-engaged countries (2017-2050)."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0))

saveRDS(fig_pd_global_cumulative,
        paste0(slides_dir, "sl_pd_fig_global_cumulative.rds"))
saveRDS(dt_pd_annual, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_pd_annual_combined.rds"))
message("PD saved: sl_pd_fig_global_cumulative.rds, sl_pd_annual_combined.rds")
```

```{r pd-pareto-combined-paho, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# ---- Combined Pareto chart with Latin America & Caribbean merged to "PAHO" --
# Take per-country combined totals, fold all LAC countries into a single
# pseudo-country, then rank and keep Top 20 + "Rest of countries".
dt_pareto_paho <- copy(dt_pd_country)

# Merge all Latin America & Caribbean countries into a single PAHO row
lac_mask <- dt_pareto_paho$region == "Latin America and Caribbean" &
              !is.na(dt_pareto_paho$region)
paho_total <- dt_pareto_paho[lac_mask,
  .(location = "PAHO (Latin America & Caribbean)",
    htn_averted      = sum(htn_averted,      na.rm = TRUE),
    tfa_averted      = sum(tfa_averted,      na.rm = TRUE),
    combined_averted = sum(combined_averted, na.rm = TRUE),
    region           = "Latin America and Caribbean")]
dt_pareto_paho <- rbind(dt_pareto_paho[!lac_mask], paho_total, fill = TRUE)

# Rank by combined deaths averted
setorder(dt_pareto_paho, -combined_averted)

top20 <- head(dt_pareto_paho, 20)
rest <- dt_pareto_paho[!location %in% top20$location,
  .(location = "Rest of countries",
    htn_averted      = sum(htn_averted,      na.rm = TRUE),
    tfa_averted      = sum(tfa_averted,      na.rm = TRUE),
    combined_averted = sum(combined_averted, na.rm = TRUE),
    region           = NA_character_)]

dt_pareto_combined_paho <- rbind(top20, rest, fill = TRUE)
setorder(dt_pareto_combined_paho, -combined_averted)
dt_pareto_combined_paho[, deaths_averted := combined_averted]
dt_pareto_combined_paho[, cum_deaths := cumsum(deaths_averted)]
dt_pareto_combined_paho[, cum_pct := cum_deaths / sum(deaths_averted)]
dt_pareto_combined_paho[, location := factor(location, levels = location)]

y_max_p <- max(dt_pareto_combined_paho$deaths_averted, na.rm = TRUE)
dt_pareto_combined_paho[, y_max_p := y_max_p]
dt_pareto_combined_paho[, cum_scaled := cum_pct * y_max_p]

# Build sec_axis formula with literal value so the plot is self-contained when saved as RDS
sec_axis_pareto <- substitute(~ . / ymp, list(ymp = y_max_p))

p_pd_pareto_combined <- ggplot(dt_pareto_combined_paho, aes(x = location)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = deaths_averted), fill = "#4B2E83") +
  geom_line(aes(y = cum_scaled, group = 1),
            color = "#85754D", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = cum_scaled),
             color = "#85754D", size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma,
    name   = "Deaths Averted (2017-2050)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = as.formula(sec_axis_pareto),
      name = "Cumulative percentage",
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    title = "Combined Interventions: Top Countries by Deaths Averted",
    subtitle = "Latin America & Caribbean countries aggregated as PAHO"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40"))

saveRDS(p_pd_pareto_combined,
        paste0(slides_dir, "sl_pd_pareto_combined.rds"))
saveRDS(dt_pareto_combined_paho,
        paste0(slides_dir, "sl_pd_pareto_combined_data.rds"))
message("PD saved: sl_pd_pareto_combined.rds (PAHO-merged Pareto)")
```

```{r pd-combined-scalars, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Combined totals and framing scalars for inline R refs ------------------
grand_combined_pd <- sum(dt_pd_country$combined_averted, na.rm = TRUE)

sl_pd_scalars <- list(
  # Model outputs - combined totals
  n_countries           = n_countries,
  n_htn_countries       = n_htn_countries,
  n_tfa_countries       = n_tfa_countries,
  study_years           = study_years,
  year_min              = year_min,
  year_max              = year_max,
  grand_combined        = grand_combined_pd,
  grand_combined_fmt    = formatC(round(grand_combined_pd), format = "d",
                                   big.mark = ","),
  grand_combined_m      = formatC(round(grand_combined_pd / 1e6, 1),
                                   format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ","),
  daily_averted_fmt     = formatC(round(grand_combined_pd / ((year_max - 2017 + 1) * 365)),
                                   format = "d", big.mark = ","),
  n_years               = year_max - year_min + 1,

  # --- Problem-framing scalars (external public sources) ---
  # Source: GBD 2023 (IHME). CVD remains the leading cause of death globally.
  cvd_deaths_global     = "19.2 million",     # annual CVD deaths, GBD 2023
  cvd_share_noncomm     = "approximately one-third",  # of all global deaths
  # Source: WHO Global Report on Hypertension (2023/2025 update); Lancet 2025
  htn_adults_global     = "1.3 billion",       # adults living with hypertension
  htn_uncontrolled_pct  = "over 75%",          # of adults with HTN not controlled
  htn_undiagnosed_share = "nearly half",        # of adults with HTN undiagnosed
  htn_deaths_annual     = "10.8 million",      # deaths attributable to high SBP (GBD 2023)
  # Source: WHO REPLACE / WHO TFA policy tracker (as of 2024)
  tfa_deaths_annual     = "500,000",            # annual IHD deaths attributable to TFA
  tfa_protected_pop     = "3.4 billion",        # covered by best-practice TFA policies
  tfa_unprotected_pop   = "roughly 5 billion",  # without best-practice protection
  tfa_countries_bpp     = "53",                 # countries with WHO best-practice TFA policy
  tfa_countries_none    = "over 130",           # countries without any TFA policy
  # Source: RTSL program pages (resolvetosavelives.org)
  rtsl_htn_countries    = "30+",                # countries with RTSL HTN program support
  rtsl_htn_enrolled     = "30 million",         # patients enrolled in RTSL-supported HTN programs
  # Source: Lancet 2025 (S0140-6736(25)02208-1) - CVD burden synthesis
  lmic_cvd_share        = "over 80%",           # of CVD deaths occurring in LMICs
  premature_cvd_lmic    = "over three-quarters" # of premature CVD deaths in LMICs
)

saveRDS(sl_pd_scalars, paste0(slides_dir, "sl_pd_scalars.rds"))
message("PD saved: sl_pd_scalars.rds")
```

```{r pd-excel-export, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- Dedicated Excel workbook for the donors/partners presentation ---------
# One sheet per figure/table used in the deck.
wb_pd <- createWorkbook()

add_sheet_pd <- function(sheet_name, dat, title_str) {
  addWorksheet(wb_pd, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb_pd, sheet_name, title_str, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
  addStyle(wb_pd, sheet_name,
           style = createStyle(fontSize = 12, textDecoration = "bold"),
           rows = 1, cols = 1)
  writeData(wb_pd, sheet_name, dat, startRow = 3, startCol = 1,
            headerStyle = createStyle(textDecoration = "bold",
                                      fgFill = "#4B2E83",
                                      fontColour = "white",
                                      border = "Bottom"))
  setColWidths(wb_pd, sheet_name, cols = seq_len(ncol(dat)), widths = "auto")
}

# Fig: Cumulative deaths averted over time (combined)
add_sheet_pd("Fig_Cumulative_Averted",
             as.data.frame(dt_pd_annual),
             "Annual and cumulative deaths averted (HTN + TFA combined), all RTSL countries.")

# Fig: PAHO-merged Pareto chart data
add_sheet_pd("Fig_Pareto_Combined_PAHO",
             as.data.frame(dt_pareto_combined_paho[, .(
               location = as.character(location), htn_averted, tfa_averted,
               deaths_averted, cum_deaths, cum_pct)]),
             "Combined Pareto (top 20 + Rest). LAC countries merged into single PAHO bar.")

# Tbl: Per-country combined totals
add_sheet_pd("Tbl_Country_Combined",
             as.data.frame(dt_pd_country),
             "Per-country combined deaths averted (HTN + TFA, 2017-2050).")

# Tbl: Regional summary (combined)
add_sheet_pd("Tbl_Region_Combined",
             as.data.frame(sl_pd_tab_region),
             "Deaths averted by region (HTN + TFA combined).")

# Tbl: Top-10 countries for presentation

             as.data.frame(readRDS(paste0(slides_dir, "sl_pd_tab_top_countries.rds"))),
             "Top 10 countries/regions by combined deaths averted (PAHO-merged).")

# Tbl: Grand totals summary used on title impact slide

               Metric = c("Countries", "HTN countries", "TFA countries",

# Reference: problem-framing scalars with sources
```
