# 100 Million Lives: Four-Intervention Country Slides

```{r ml100-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# ---- FIXED palette, labels, legend order (do not change) --------------------
ml100_label_map <- c(
  "Improved Hypertension Control" = "HTN",
  "Population Sodium Reduction"    = "Sodium",
  "TFA Elimination"               = "TFA",
  "Improved Statin Uptake"        = "Statins"
)
ml100_levels <- c("Statins", "TFA", "Sodium", "HTN")   # legend order (top->bottom)
ml100_cols <- c(
  "HTN"     = "#E7298A",   # pink
  "Sodium"  = "#1F77B4",   # blue
  "TFA"     = "#F58025",   # orange
  "Statins" = "#2CA02C"    # green
)

# Clean, readable country labels for chart axes
ml100_clean_loc <- function(x) {
  repl <- c(
    "Russian Federation"                    = "Russia",
    "Iran (Islamic Republic of)"            = "Iran",
    "Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of)"    = "Venezuela",
    "Bolivia (Plurinational State of)"      = "Bolivia",
    "Democratic People's Republic of Korea" = "North Korea",
    "Republic of Korea"                     = "South Korea",
    "Democratic Republic of the Congo"      = "DR Congo",
    "United Republic of Tanzania"           = "Tanzania",
    "Lao People's Democratic Republic"      = "Laos",
    "Syrian Arab Republic"                  = "Syria",
    "Viet Nam"                              = "Vietnam",
    "Taiwan (Province of China)"            = "Taiwan",
    "Republic of Moldova"                   = "Moldova"
  )
  out <- unname(repl[x]); ifelse(is.na(out), x, out)
}

# ---- Read the 100M-lives output (self-contained; NOT model RDS) -------------
ml100_path <- paste0(wd_data, "UWRTSL-100MLives_Output20260204.xlsx")
dt_ml100   <- as.data.table(read.xlsx(ml100_path, sheet = "Location And Cause"))
dt_ml100[, int_lbl := ml100_label_map[intervention]]

# ---- Aggregation totals (used for sanity check + summary table) -------------
ml100_tot <- dt_ml100[, .(deaths_delayed = sum(deaths_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)),
                      by = intervention]
ml100_comp_sum  <- ml100_tot[intervention != "All Interventions", sum(deaths_delayed)]
ml100_all_total <- ml100_tot[intervention == "All Interventions", deaths_delayed]

message(sprintf("ML100 totals (M): HTN %.1f | Sodium %.1f | TFA %.1f | Statins %.1f | sum-4 %.1f | All %.1f",
  ml100_tot[intervention == "Improved Hypertension Control", deaths_delayed] / 1e6,
  ml100_tot[intervention == "Population Sodium Reduction",   deaths_delayed] / 1e6,
  ml100_tot[intervention == "TFA Elimination",               deaths_delayed] / 1e6,
  ml100_tot[intervention == "Improved Statin Uptake",        deaths_delayed] / 1e6,
  ml100_comp_sum / 1e6, ml100_all_total / 1e6))
```

## Sanity Check --- Per-Intervention Totals

```{r ml100-sanity, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
ml100_sanity <- copy(ml100_tot)
ml100_sanity[, Millions := formatC(deaths_delayed / 1e6, format = "f",
                                   digits = 1, big.mark = ",")]
ml100_sanity[, intervention := factor(intervention,
  levels = c("Improved Hypertension Control", "Population Sodium Reduction",
             "Improved Statin Uptake", "TFA Elimination", "All Interventions"))]
setorder(ml100_sanity, intervention)

kable(ml100_sanity[, .(Intervention = intervention,
                       `Deaths delayed (millions)` = Millions)],
      caption = paste0(
        "Sanity check: cumulative deaths delayed (2026–2050) by intervention. ",
        "Sum of the four single interventions = ",
        formatC(ml100_comp_sum / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 1), "M; ",
        "All Interventions (combined) = ",
        formatC(ml100_all_total / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 1), "M. ",
        "The combined estimate is lower than the arithmetic sum because deaths ",
        "preventable by more than one intervention are counted once."),
      align = "lr") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 13) |>
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

## Task 1 --- Country Stacked Bar + Summary Table

```{r ml100-task1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
# Rank countries by the All-Interventions total (descending)
ml100_rank <- dt_ml100[intervention == "All Interventions",
                       .(location, all_tot = deaths_delayed)]
setorder(ml100_rank, -all_tot)
top20_locs <- head(ml100_rank$location, 20)

# Stack the four single interventions; collapse the remainder into "Rest"
dt_comp <- dt_ml100[intervention != "All Interventions"]
dt_comp[, grp := fifelse(location %in% top20_locs, location, "Rest of countries")]
dt_bar <- dt_comp[, .(deaths_delayed = sum(deaths_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)),
                  by = .(grp, int_lbl)]

# Bar order: top 20 desc, then "Rest of countries" last; largest at top
ord_raw   <- c(ml100_rank[location %in% top20_locs][order(-all_tot), location],
               "Rest of countries")
clean_one <- function(g) if (g == "Rest of countries") "Rest of countries" else ml100_clean_loc(g)
ord_clean <- vapply(ord_raw, clean_one, character(1))
dt_bar[, grp_clean := vapply(grp, clean_one, character(1))]
dt_bar[, grp_clean := factor(grp_clean, levels = rev(ord_clean))]
dt_bar[, int_lbl   := factor(int_lbl, levels = ml100_levels)]

country_stacked_bar <- ggplot(dt_bar,
       aes(x = deaths_delayed / 1e6, y = grp_clean, fill = int_lbl)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ml100_cols, breaks = ml100_levels, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
                     labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(title    = "Where the lives are saved, by country",
       subtitle = "Four single interventions stacked; cumulative 2026–2050",
       x = "Deaths delayed (millions)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position    = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"))
print(country_stacked_bar)

# Right-hand summary table: Policy | Lives saved (millions) | % of total.
# % of total = share of the summed single-intervention impact (matches the
# reference slide pattern: HTN 59 / Sodium 29 / Statins 9 / TFA 4).
tab <- ml100_tot[intervention != "All Interventions"]
tab[, int_lbl := ml100_label_map[intervention]]
tab[, pct := deaths_delayed / ml100_comp_sum]
setorder(tab, -deaths_delayed)
country_summary_table <- data.table(
  Policy                   = tab$int_lbl,
  `Lives saved (millions)` = formatC(tab$deaths_delayed / 1e6, format = "f",
                                     digits = 1, big.mark = ","),
  `% of total`             = paste0(round(tab$pct * 100), "%")
)
country_summary_table <- rbind(
  country_summary_table,
  data.table(Policy = "All Interventions",
             `Lives saved (millions)` = formatC(ml100_all_total / 1e6, format = "f",
                                                digits = 1, big.mark = ","),
             `% of total` = "—")
)

saveRDS(country_stacked_bar,   paste0(slides_dir, "country_stacked_bar.rds"))
saveRDS(country_summary_table, paste0(slides_dir, "country_summary_table.rds"))
message("ML100 saved: country_stacked_bar.rds, country_summary_table.rds")
```

## Task 2 --- PAHO-Merged Pareto (Stacked Interventions + Cumulative %)

```{r ml100-task2, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# Explicit PAHO (Latin America & Caribbean) member vector --- sheet naming.
paho_members <- c(
  "Antigua and Barbuda", "Argentina", "Bahamas", "Barbados", "Belize", "Bolivia",
  "Brazil", "Chile", "Colombia", "Costa Rica", "Cuba", "Dominica",
  "Dominican Republic", "Ecuador", "El Salvador", "Grenada", "Guatemala",
  "Guyana", "Haiti", "Honduras", "Jamaica", "Mexico", "Nicaragua", "Panama",
  "Paraguay", "Peru", "Puerto Rico", "Saint Lucia",
  "Saint Vincent and the Grenadines", "Suriname", "Trinidad and Tobago",
  "Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of)"
)

# ---- Classification flags so the PAHO membership can be reviewed ------------
sheet_locs   <- unique(dt_ml100$location)
paho_missing <- setdiff(paho_members, sheet_locs)   # vector names absent from sheet
lac_csv_missed <- character(0)                       # CSV-LAC countries the vector omits
if (exists("countries_dt")) {
  lac_csv <- countries_dt[region == "Latin America and Caribbean", unique(location)]
  lac_csv_missed <- setdiff(intersect(lac_csv, sheet_locs), paho_members)
}
ml100_unclassified <- list(
  paho_members_not_in_sheet  = paho_missing,
  csv_LAC_not_in_paho_vector = lac_csv_missed
)
message("ML100 PAHO flags | members not in sheet: ",
        if (length(paho_missing)) paste(paho_missing, collapse = ", ") else "(none)",
        " | CSV-LAC not in vector: ",
        if (length(lac_csv_missed)) paste(lac_csv_missed, collapse = ", ") else "(none)")
saveRDS(ml100_unclassified, paste0(slides_dir, "pareto_paho_unclassified.rds"))

# ---- Merge LAC into a single PAHO entity, then rank -------------------------
dt_p <- dt_ml100[intervention != "All Interventions",
                 .(location, int_lbl, deaths_delayed)]
dt_p[, entity := fifelse(location %in% paho_members,
                         "PAHO (Latin America & Caribbean)", location)]
dt_ent <- dt_p[, .(deaths_delayed = sum(deaths_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)),
               by = .(entity, int_lbl)]

ent_tot <- dt_ent[, .(tot = sum(deaths_delayed)), by = entity]
setorder(ent_tot, -tot)
top20_ent <- head(ent_tot$entity, 20)

dt_ent[, grp := fifelse(entity %in% top20_ent, entity, "Rest of countries")]
dt_grp <- dt_ent[, .(deaths_delayed = sum(deaths_delayed, na.rm = TRUE)),
                 by = .(grp, int_lbl)]

# Order: top 20 entities desc, then "Rest of countries" forced LAST (Pareto tail)
grp_tot <- dt_grp[, .(tot = sum(deaths_delayed)), by = grp]
ord_ent <- c(setdiff(grp_tot[order(-tot), grp], "Rest of countries"),
             "Rest of countries")
clean_ent <- function(g) {
  if (g == "Rest of countries") "Rest of countries"
  else if (g == "PAHO (Latin America & Caribbean)") "PAHO (LAC)"
  else ml100_clean_loc(g)
}
ord_ent_clean <- vapply(ord_ent, clean_ent, character(1))

dt_grp[, grp_clean := vapply(grp, clean_ent, character(1))]
dt_grp[, grp_clean := factor(grp_clean, levels = ord_ent_clean)]
dt_grp[, int_lbl   := factor(int_lbl, levels = ml100_levels)]
dt_grp[, dd_M := deaths_delayed / 1e6]

# Cumulative-% line (computed in plotting order)
dt_line <- dt_grp[, .(tot_M = sum(dd_M)), by = grp_clean]
setorder(dt_line, grp_clean)
dt_line[, cum_M     := cumsum(tot_M)]
dt_line[, cum_pct   := cum_M / sum(tot_M)]
y_max_M <- max(dt_line$tot_M, na.rm = TRUE)
dt_line[, cum_scaled := cum_pct * y_max_M]

# Bake the literal y_max into the sec-axis formula so the saved ggplot object
# is self-contained when loaded in the presentation's environment (the loading
# env has no y_max_M). Captured via substitute() + as.formula().
sec_form <- substitute(~ . / ymp, list(ymp = y_max_M))

pareto_paho <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = dt_grp,
           aes(x = grp_clean, y = dd_M, fill = int_lbl), width = 0.80) +
  geom_line(data = dt_line,
            aes(x = grp_clean, y = cum_scaled, group = 1),
            color = "#4B2E83", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = dt_line,
             aes(x = grp_clean, y = cum_scaled),
             color = "#4B2E83", size = 1.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ml100_cols, breaks = ml100_levels, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name   = "Deaths delayed (millions)",
    labels = label_number(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(trans = as.formula(sec_form),
                        name = "Cumulative %",
                        labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1))
  ) +
  labs(title    = "Concentration of impact across countries",
       subtitle = "Four interventions stacked; Latin America & Caribbean merged as PAHO; cumulative 2026–2050",
       x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position  = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9))
print(pareto_paho)

saveRDS(pareto_paho, paste0(slides_dir, "pareto_paho.rds"))
saveRDS(dt_grp,      paste0(slides_dir, "pareto_paho_data.rds"))
message("ML100 saved: pareto_paho.rds, pareto_paho_data.rds")
```
